original_ai_output.title_zh: 团结州高等法院在本提乌流离失所者营地结束庭审
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹团结州高等法院在本提乌境内流离失所者营地结束庭审，审理涉及毒品犯罪、帮派暴力和性暴力的刑事案件。据联合国南苏丹特派团称，自9月7日开庭以来，法院已审结20起刑事案件，17人被判有罪，14人被无罪释放或撤诉。社区代表报告称营地安全明显改善，帮派暴力和毒品供应大幅减少。

location.site: 本提乌境内流离失所者营地
location.raw_text: Bentiu camp for Internally Displaced People (IDPs), Unity State

key_facts.fact: 团结州高等法院在本提乌流离失所者营地结束庭审
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Unity State High Court concludes proceedings in Bentiu IDP camp

key_facts.fact: 法院自9月7日开庭以来审结20起刑事案件，17人被判有罪，14人被无罪释放或撤诉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: since beginning proceedings in the camp on 7 September, the High Court has adjudicated 20 criminal cases... The 20 cases decided resulted in 17 individuals convicted, while 14 individuals were acquitted or had their cases dismissed.

key_facts.fact: 法院审理涉及毒品犯罪、帮派暴力和性暴力的案件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: it heard criminal cases involving drug-related offences, gang violence, and sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV)

key_facts.fact: 本提乌营地是南苏丹最大的境内流离失所者营地，收容超过10万人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Bentiu camp is South Sudan's largest camp for internally displaced persons, hosting more than 100,000 people.

key_facts.fact: 社区代表报告营地安全明显改善，帮派暴力和毒品供应大幅减少
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Community representatives reported a significant improvement in security in the camp during the court's presence, including a marked reduction in gang violence and insecurity, while the availability of drugs was reported to have reduced substantially.

uncertainties: 社区代表报告的安全改善情况尚未获得独立核实
目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
